suite: EMS Commercial Legal Frozen Regression Corpus v0.1
purpose: Regression cases for source-grounded issue spotting. These are not approved negotiation standards.

cases.text: Supplier may purchase material against Customer's twelve-week forecast. Customer may reduce or cancel forecasts at any time. Supplier shall be solely responsible for all excess, obsolete, non-cancelable and non-returnable material.
mustNotConclude: customer is obligated to purchase the inventory

cases.text: Customer may terminate this Agreement for convenience on thirty days' notice. On termination Customer will pay only for conforming finished goods delivered before the termination effective date.
Payment terms are Net 90 from receipt of a correct invoice.
Supplier's liability shall be unlimited. The exclusion of consequential damages does not apply to Customer's lost profits, lost revenue, recall costs or loss of business.
Supplier warrants that Products will meet all Customer requirements and intended use for sixty months after shipment, including defects arising from Customer design specifications.
Prices are firm and fixed for the term and will not be adjusted for tariff increases, foreign exchange movement, commodity increases, labor cost changes or changes in law.
The MSA states payment is Net 45. This SOW states payment is Net 90 and provides that the SOW controls over conflicting terms in the MSA.
The parties will meet quarterly to review operational performance. Meeting minutes are informational and do not amend this Agreement unless signed by authorized representatives of both parties.
mustNotConclude: quarterly meeting creates a purchase obligation
